name: build-pipeline-non-graph-artifacts
body: Build-toolchain pins live in tracked files the structural scanner graphs: `.github/workflows/release.yml` (YAML), `install.sh` (sh), and `Cargo.toml` (toml) carry `File` nodes (`code_type = 'config'`), so each is an `implemented-by`-targetable identity. `rust.build_script_build` (build.rs) is the graph-visible half of the pipeline. Ruby (`Formula/*.rb`, the pending `apg-ruby` frontend) carries a residual `misc` `File` node lacking Module/Struct/Function facts, so the formula edits ride as non-graph maintainer tasks in the plan.
